pli-tv-kd2:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
pli-tv-kd2:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā dhammaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd2:1.1.4: te labhanti aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu pemaṃ. labhanti pasādaṃ, labhanti aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pakkhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:1.2.1: atha kho rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd2:1.2.2: “etarahi kho aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā dhammaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd2:1.2.4: te labhanti aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu pemaṃ. labhanti pasādaṃ. labhanti aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pakkhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:1.2.5: yannūna ayyāpi cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipateyyu”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.1: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:-
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.3: “idha mayhaṃ bhante, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi: ‘etarahi kho aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā dhammaṃ bhāsanti.
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.5: te labhanti aññatitthiyesu paribbājakesu pemaṃ. labhanti pasādaṃ. labhanti aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pakkhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.6: yannūna ayyāpi cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipateyyu’nti.
pli-tv-kd2:1.3.7: sādhu bhante, ayyāpi cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipateyyu”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:1.4.1: atha kho bhagavā rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandessesi samādapesi. samuttejesi. sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd2:1.4.2: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd2:1.4.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd2:1.4.4: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.2: “bhagavatā anuññātaṃ cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitu”nti
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.3: cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā tuṇhī nisīdanti.
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.6: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā tuṇhī nisīdissanti seyyathāpi mūgasūkarā?
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.10: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd2:2.1.11: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa sannipatitvā dhammaṃ bhāsitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.1.1: atha kho bhagavato rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd2:3.1.2: “yannūnāhaṃ yāni mayā bhikkhūnaṃ paññattāni sikkhāpadāni, tāni nesaṃ pātimokkhuddesaṃ anujāneyyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:3.2.1: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd2:3.2.2: “idha mayhaṃ bhikkhave, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi: ‘yannūnāhaṃ yāni mayā bhikkhūnaṃ paññattāni sikkhāpadāni, tāni nesaṃ pātimokkhuddesaṃ anujāneyyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.4: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho uposathaṃ kareyya. pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.8: taṃ sabbeva santā sādhukaṃ suṇoma. manasi karoma.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.11: tuṇhībhāvena kho panāyasmante parisuddhā ti vedissāmi.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.12: yathā kho pana paccekapuṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti, evamevaṃ evarūpāya parisāya yāvatatiyaṃ anusāvitaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.13: yo pana bhikkhu yāva tatiyaṃ anussāviyamāne saramāno santiṃ āpattiṃ nāvīkareyya, sampajānamusāvādassa hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.14: sampajānamusāvādo kho panāyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.3.15: tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddhāpekkhena santī āpatti āvīkātabbā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.4.2: ādimetaṃ mukhametaṃ pamukhametaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ. tena vuccati “pātimokkha”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.4.6: ācikkhissāmi. desissāmi. paññapessāmi. paṭṭhapessāmi. vivarissāmi. vibhajissāmi. uttānī karissāmi. pakāsissāmi. “taṃ”
pli-tv-kd2:3.4.10: yāvatikā tassā parisāya therā ca navā ca majjhimā ca, ete vuccanti sabbeva santā ti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.5.2: therassa vā navassa vā majjhimassa vā pañcannaṃ vā āpattikkhandhānaṃ aññatarā āpatti. sattannaṃ vā āpattikkhandhānaṃ aññatarā āpatti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.5.4: so deseyya, so vivareyya, so uttāniṃ kareyya, so pakāseyya saṅghamajjhe vā gaṇamajjhe vā ekapuggale vā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.5.6: anajjhāpannā vā hoti, āpajjitvā vā vuṭṭhitā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.1: “yathā kho pana paccekapuṭṭhassa veyyākaraṇaṃ hotī” ti
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.2: yathā ekena eko puṭṭho byākareyya, evameva tassā parisāya jānitabbaṃ maṃ pucchatī ti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.6: sakimpi anusāvitaṃ hoti. dutiyampi anusāvitaṃ hoti. tatiyampi anusāvitaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.10: ajjhāpannā vā hoti. āpajjitvā vā avuṭṭhitā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.6.12: na deseyya. na vivareyya. na uttānī kareyya, na pakāseyya saṅghamajjhe vā gaṇamajjhe vā ekapuggale vā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.7.6: paṭhamassa jhānassa adhigamāya antarāyiko. dutiyassa jhānassa adhigamāya antarāyiko. tatiyassa jhānassa adhigamāya antarāyiko. catutthassa jhānassa adhigamāya antarāyiko. jhānānaṃ vimokkhānaṃ samādhīnaṃ samāpattīnaṃ nekkhammānaṃ nissaraṇānaṃ pavivekānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhigamāya antarāyiko.
pli-tv-kd2:3.8.2: ajjhāpannā vā hoti, āpajjitvā vā avuṭṭhitā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.8.4: āvīkātabbā saṅghamajjhe vā gaṇamajjhe vā ekapuggale vā.
pli-tv-kd2:3.8.7: paṭhamassa jhānassa adhigamāya phāsu hoti. dutiyassa jhānassa adhigamāya phāsu hoti. tatiyassa jhānassa adhigamāya phāsu hoti, catutthassa jhānassa adhigamāya phāsu hoti. jhānānaṃ vimokkhānaṃ samādhīnaṃ samāpattīnaṃ nekkhammānaṃ nissaraṇānaṃ pavivekānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ adhigamāya phāsu hotī ti.
pli-tv-kd2:4.2.3: pakkhassa tikkhattuṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti cātuddase paṇṇarase aṭṭhamiyā ca pakkhassa.
pli-tv-kd2:4.2.5: na bhikkhave pakkhassa tikkhattuṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:4.2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave, sakiṃ pakkhassa cātuddase vā paṇṇarase vā pātimokkhaṃ uddisitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū yathāparisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti sakāya sakāya parisāya.
pli-tv-kd2:5.1.3: “na bhikkhave, yathāparisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ sakāya sakāya parisāya.
pli-tv-kd2:5.2.4: kittāvatā nu kho sāmaggi hoti yāvatā ekāvāso? udāhu sabbā puthuvī”ti?
pli-tv-kd2:5.3.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākappino rājagahe viharati maddakucchimhi migadāye.
pli-tv-kd2:5.3.2: atha kho āyasmato mahākappinassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd2:5.3.3: “gaccheyyaṃ vāhaṃ uposathaṃ? na vā gaccheyyaṃ? gaccheyyaṃ vāhaṃ saṅghakammaṃ? na vā gaccheyyaṃ? atha khvāhaṃ visuddho paramāya visuddhiyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:5.4.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato mahākappinassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya –
pli-tv-kd2:5.4.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito maddakucchismiṃ migadāye āyasmato mahākappinassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd2:5.4.4: āyasmāpi kho mahākappino bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahākappinaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.2: “nanu te kappina, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi?
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.3: gaccheyyaṃ vāhaṃ uposathaṃ? na vā gaccheyyaṃ? gaccheyyaṃ vāhaṃ saṅghakammaṃ? na vā gaccheyyaṃ? atha khvāhaṃ visuddho paramāya visuddhiyā”ti?
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.5: “tumhe ce brāhmaṇā uposathaṃ na sakkarissatha, na garu karissatha, na mānessatha, na pūjessatha, atha ko carahi uposathaṃ sakkarissati? garu karissati? mānessati? pūjessati?
pli-tv-kd2:5.5.6: gaccha tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, uposathaṃ. mā no agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd2:5.6.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ mahākappinaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā
pli-tv-kd2:5.6.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva maddakucchimhi migadāye āyasmato mahākappinassa pamukhe antarahito gijjhakūṭe pabbate pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd2:6.1.3: ettāvatā sāmaggi yāvatā ekāvāso ti. kittāvatā nu kho ekāvāso hotī?”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:6.1.8: pabbatanimittaṃ pāsāṇanimittaṃ vananimittaṃ rukkhanimittaṃ, magganimittaṃ vammikanimittaṃ nadīnimittaṃ udakanimittaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:6.1.9: nimitte kittetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd2:6.1.12: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho etehi nimittehi sīmaṃ sammanneyya samānasaṃvāsaṃ ekūposathaṃ
pli-tv-kd2:6.2.3: saṅgho etehi nimittehi sīmaṃ sammannati samānasaṃvāsaṃ ekūposathaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:6.2.4: yassāyasmato khamati etehi nimittehi sīmāya sammuti samānasaṃvāsāya ekūposathāya, so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-kd2:6.2.6: sammatā sīmā saṅghena etehi nimittehi samānasaṃvāsā ekūposathā.
pli-tv-kd2:6.2.7: khamati saṅghassa. tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.3: atimahatiyo sīmāyo sammannanti catuyojanikāpi pañcayojanikāpi chayojanikāpi.
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.4: bhikkhū uposathaṃ āgacchantā uddisamānepi pātimokkhe āgacchanti. uddiṭṭhamattepi āgacchanti. antarāpi parivasanti.
pli-tv-kd2:7.1.6: “na bhikkhave atimahatī sīmā sammannitabbā, catuyojanikā vā pañcayojanikā vā chayojanikā vā.
pli-tv-kd2:7.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nadīpāraṃ sīmaṃ sammannanti.
pli-tv-kd2:7.2.2: uposathaṃ āgacchantā bhikkhūpi vuyhanti. pattāpi vuyhanti. cīvarānipi vuyhanti.
pli-tv-kd2:7.2.6: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, yatthassa dhuva nāvā vā dhuva setu vā, evarūpaṃ nadīpārasīmaṃ sammannitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:8.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū anupariveṇiyaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti. asaṅketena
pli-tv-kd2:8.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave, uposathāgāraṃ sammannitvā uposathaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ saṅgho ākaṅkhati vihāraṃ vā aḍḍhayogaṃ vā pāsādaṃ vā hammiyaṃ vā guhaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:8.2.3: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ vihāraṃ uposathāgāraṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:8.2.7: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa vihārassa uposathāgārassa sammuti, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd2:8.2.10: khamati saṅghassa. tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:8.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse dve uposathāgārāni sammatāni honti.
pli-tv-kd2:8.3.5: “na bhikkhave, ekasmiṃ āvāse dve uposathāgārāni sammannitabbāni.
pli-tv-kd2:8.3.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave, ekaṃ samūhanitvā ekattha uposathaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:8.4.4: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ uposathāgāraṃ samūhaneyya
pli-tv-kd2:8.4.8: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa uposathāgārassa samugghāto, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd2:8.4.11: khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse atikhuddakaṃ uposathāgāraṃ sammataṃ hoti. tadahuposathe mahābhikkhusaṅgho sannipatito hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.2: bhikkhū asammatāya bhūmiyā nisinnā pātimokkhaṃ assosuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.5: uposathāgāraṃ sammannitvā uposatho kātabbo ti. mayañcamha asammatāya bhūmiyā nisinnā pātimokkhaṃ assosumhā. kato nu kho amhākaṃ uposatho? akato nu kho?”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:9.1.7: “sammatāya vā bhikkhave, bhūmiyā nisinno asammatāya vā yato pātimokkhaṃ suṇāti, katovassa uposatho.
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.1: tena hi bhikkhave, saṅgho yāvamahantaṃ uposathapamukhaṃ ākaṅkhati, tāvamahantaṃ uposathapamukhaṃ sammannatu.
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.4: nimitte kittetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.7: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho etehi nimittehi uposathapamukhaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.12: yassāyasmato khamati etehi nimittehi uposathapamukhassa sammuti, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd2:9.2.15: khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahuposathe navakā bhikkhū paṭhamataraṃ sannipatitvā
pli-tv-kd2:10.1.6: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, tadahuposathe therehi bhikkhūhi paṭhamataraṃ sannipatitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena rājagahe sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā honti.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.3: “amhākaṃ āvāse uposatho karīyatu. amhākaṃ āvāse uposatho karīyatū”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.5: “idha pana bhikkhave, sambahulā āvāsā samānasīmā honti.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.7: ‘amhākaṃ āvāse uposatho karīyatu. amhākaṃ āvāse uposatho karīyatū’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.8: tehi bhikkhave, bhikkhūhi sabbeheva ekajjhaṃ sannipatitvā uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:11.1.9: yattha vā pana thero bhikkhu viharati, tattha sannipatitvā uposatho kātabbo,
pli-tv-kd2:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo andhakavindā rājagahaṃ uposathaṃ āgacchanto antarāmagge nadiṃ taranto manaṃ vūḷho ahosi. cīvarānissa allāni.
pli-tv-kd2:12.1.4: “idāhaṃ āvuso andhakavindā rājagahaṃ uposathaṃ āgacchanto antarāmagge nadiṃ taranto manamhi vūḷho.
pli-tv-kd2:12.1.7: “yā sā bhikkhave, saṅghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekūposathā, saṅgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammannatu.
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.4: yā sā saṅghena sīmā sammatā samānasaṃvāsā ekūposathā, yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammanneyya.
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.7: yā sā saṅghena sīmā sammatā samāna saṃvāsā ekūposathā, saṅgho taṃ sīmaṃ ticīvarena avippavāsaṃ sammannati.
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.8: yassāyasmato khamati etissā sīmāya ticīvarena avippavāsāya sammuti, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.10: sammatā sā sīmā saṅghena ticīvarena avippavāsā
pli-tv-kd2:12.2.11: khamati saṅghassa. tasmā tuṇhī. eva metaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:12.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū “bhagavatā ticīvarena avippavāsasammuti anuññātā”ti antaraghare cīvarāni nikkhipanti.

pli-tv-kd2:21.1.3: “idha pana bhikkhave, sambahulā bhikkhū bālā abyattā disaṃgamikā ācariyupajjhāye na āpucchanti,
pli-tv-kd2:21.1.6: “te ce bhikkhave, bālā abyattā aññe bāle abyatte apadiseyyuṃ, na bhikkhave, ācariyupajjhāyehi anujānitabbā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.1.8: te ca bhikkhave, bālā abyattā ananuññātā ācariyupajjhāyehi gaccheyyuṃ ce, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ āvāse sambahulā bhikkhū viharanti bālā abyattā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.2: te na jānanti uposathaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā pātimokkhaṃ vā pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.3: tattha añño bhikkhu āgacchati bahussuto āgatāgamo dhammadharo vinayadharo mātikādharo paṇḍito byatto medhāvī lajjī kukkuccako sikkhākāmo.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.4: tehi bhikkhave, bhikkhūhi so bhikkhu saṅgahetabbo anuggahetabbo upalāpetabbo upaṭṭhāpetabbo cuṇṇena mattikāya dantakaṭṭhena mukhodakena.
pli-tv-kd2:21.2.5: no ce saṅgaṇheyyuṃ anuggaṇheyyuṃ upalāpeyyuṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ cuṇṇena mattikāya dantakaṭṭhena mukhodakena, āpatti dukkaṭassa.”
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahuposathe sambahulā bhikkhū viharanti bālā abyattā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.2: te na jānanti uposathaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā pātimokkhaṃ vā pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.3: tehi bhikkhave, bhikkhūhi eko bhikkhu sāmantā āvāsā sajjukaṃ pāhetabbo:
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.4: “gacchāvuso saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā pātimokkhaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā āgacchā”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:21.3.6: no ce labhetha, tehi bhikkhave, bhikkhūhi sabbeheva yattha jānanti uposathaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā pātimokkhaṃ vā pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā, so āvāso gantabbo .
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ āvāse sambahulā bhikkhū vassaṃ vasanti bālā abyattā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.2: te na jānanti uposathaṃ vā uposathakammaṃ vā pātimokkhaṃ vā pātimokkhuddesaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.3: tehi bhikkhave, bhikkhūhi eko bhikkhu sāmantā āvāsā sajjukaṃ pāhetabbo:
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.4: “gacchāvuso saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā pātimokkhaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā āgacchā”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.6: no ce labhetha, eko bhikkhu sattāhakālikaṃ pāhetabbo:
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.7: ‘gacchāvuso saṃkhittena vā vitthārena vā pātimokkhaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā āgacchā’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:21.4.9: no ce labhetha, na bhikkhave, tehi bhikkhūhi tasmiṃ āvāse vassaṃ vasitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.3: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.7: tena gilānena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.8: pārisuddhiṃ dammi. pārisuddhiṃ me hara. pārisuddhiṃ me ārocehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.9: kāyena viññāpeti, vācāya viññāpeti, kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, dinnā hoti pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.1.10: na kāyena viññāpeti, na vācāya viññāpeti, na kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, na dinnā hoti pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.2.2: no ce labhetha, so bhikkhave, gilāno bhikkhu mañcena vā pīṭhena vā saṅghamajjhe ānetvā uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:22.2.3: sace bhikkhave, gilānupaṭṭhākānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd2:22.2.4: “sace kho mayaṃ gilānaṃ ṭhānā cāvessāma, ābādho vā abhivaḍḍhissati. kālakiriyā vā bhavissatī’ti, na bhikkhave, gilāno ṭhānā cāvetabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:22.3.1: “pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave, dinnāya pārisuddhiyā tattheva pakkamati, aññassa dātabbā pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.3.2: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave, dinnāya pārisuddhiyā tattheva vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.1: “pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave, dinnāya pārisuddhiyā antarāmagge pakkamati, anāhaṭā hoti pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.2: pārisuddhihārako ce, bhikkhave, dinnāya pārisuddhiyā antarāmagge vibbhamati, …pe…
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.4: “pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave, dinnāya pārisuddhiyā saṅghappatto pakkamati, āhaṭā hoti pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.5: pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave, dinnāya pārisuddhiyā saṅghappatto vibbhamati, kālaṃ karoti, …pe…
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.7: “pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave, dinnāya pārisuddhiyā saṅghappatto sutto na āroceti, pamatto na āroceti, samāpanno na āroceti, āhaṭā hoti pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:22.4.9: “pārisuddhihārako ce bhikkhave, dinnāya pārisuddhiyā saṅghappatto sañcicca na āroceti. āhaṭā hoti pārisuddhi.
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.3: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.7: tena gilānena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjalimpaggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.8: ‘chandaṃ dammi, chandaṃ me hara, chandaṃ me ārocehī’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.9: kāyena viññāpeti, vācāya viññāpeti, kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, dinno hoti chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.1.10: na kāyena viññāpeti, na vācāya viññāpeti, na kāyena vācāya viññāpeti, na dinno hoti chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.2.2: no ce labhetha, so, bhikkhave, gilāno bhikkhu mañcena vā pīṭhena vā saṅghamajjhe ānetvā kammaṃ kātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:23.2.3: sace bhikkhave, gilānupaṭṭhākānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd2:23.2.4: ‘sace kho mayaṃ gilānaṃ ṭhānā cāvessāma, ābādho vā abhivaḍḍhissati kālaṃkiriyā vā bhavissatī’ti. na bhikkhave, gilāno ṭhānā cāvetabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.1: “chandahārako ce bhikkhave, dinne chande tattheva pakkamati, aññassa dātabbo chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.2: chandahārako ce bhikkhave, dinne chande tattheva vibbhamati,
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.24: “chandahārako ce, bhikkhave, dinne chande antarāmagge pakkamati, anāhaṭo hoti chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.25: chandahārako ce bhikkhave, dinne chande antarāmagge vibbhamati, kālaṃ karoti, …pe…
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.27: “chandahārako ce bhikkhave, dinne chande saṅghappatto pakkamati, āhaṭo hoti chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.28: chandahārako ce bhikkhave, dinne chande saṅghappatto vibbhamati, kālaṃ karoti, …pe…
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.30: “chandahārako ce bhikkhave, dinne chande saṅghappatto sutto na āroceti, pamatto na āroceti, samāpanno na āroceti, āhaṭo hoti chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.32: “chandahārako ce bhikkhave, dinne chande saṅghappatto sañcicca na āroceti, āhaṭo hoti chando.
pli-tv-kd2:23.3.34: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, tadahuposathe pārisuddhiṃ dentena chandampi dātuṃ, santi saṅghassa karaṇīya”nti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ tadahuposathe ñātakā gaṇhiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd2:24.1.3: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ tadahuposathe ñātakā gaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.1.5: “iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto imaṃ bhikkhuṃ muhuttaṃ muñcatha, yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu uposathaṃ karotī’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.2: no ce labhetha, te ñātakā bhikkhūhi evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.3: ‘iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ ekamantaṃ hotha, yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu pārisuddhiṃ detī’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.5: no ce labhetha, te ñātakā bhikkhūhi evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.6: ‘iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto imaṃ bhikkhuṃ muhuttaṃ nissīmaṃ netha, yāva saṅgho uposathaṃ karotī’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.2.8: no ce labhetha, nattheva vaggena saṅghena uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ tadahuposathe rājāno gaṇhanti, …pe…
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.4: bhikkhupaccatthikā gaṇhanti. te bhikkhupaccatthikā bhikkhūhi evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.5: ‘iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto imaṃ bhikkhuṃ muhuttaṃ muñcatha, yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu uposathaṃ karotī’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.7: no ce labhetha, te bhikkhupaccatthikā bhikkhūhi evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.8: ‘iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ ekamantaṃ hotha, yāvāyaṃ bhikkhu pārisuddhiṃ detī’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.10: no ce labhetha, te bhikkhupaccatthikā bhikkhūhi evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.11: ‘iṅgha tumhe āyasmanto imaṃ bhikkhuṃ muhuttaṃ nissīmaṃ netha, yāva saṅgho uposathaṃ karotī’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:24.3.13: no ce labhetha, natveva vaggena saṅghena uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.3: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.4: “atthi bhante, gaggo nāma bhikkhu ummattako, so anāgato”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.6: atthi bhikkhu ummattako saratipi uposathaṃ, napi sarati, saratipi saṅghakammaṃ, napi sarati, atthi neva sarati.
pli-tv-kd2:25.1.7: āgacchatipi uposathaṃ, napi āgacchati, āgacchatipi saṅghakammaṃ, napi āgacchati. atthi neva āgacchati.”
pli-tv-kd2:25.2.1: “tatra bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ ummattako saratipi, uposathaṃ na pi sarati, saratipi saṅghakammaṃ, napi sarati, āgacchatipi uposathaṃ, napi āgacchati, āgacchati pi saṅghakammaṃ na pi āgacchati. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa ummattakassa ummattakasammuttiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:25.3.5: saratipi uposathaṃ napi sarati, saratipi saṅghakammaṃ napi sarati, āgacchati pi uposathaṃ napi āgacchati, āgacchatipi saṅghakammaṃ napi āgacchati.
pli-tv-kd2:25.3.6: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho gaggassa bhikkhuno ummattakassa ummattakasammutiṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-kd2:25.3.7: sareyya vā gaggo bhikkhu uposathaṃ na vā sareyya, sareyya vā saṅghakammaṃ na vā sareyya, āgaccheyya vā uposathaṃ, na vā āgaccheyya, āgaccheyya vā saṅghakammaṃ, na vā āgaccheyya. saṅgho saha vā gaggena vinā vā gaggena uposathaṃ kareyya. saṅghakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.3: saratipi uposathaṃ, napi sarati, saratipi saṅghakammaṃ napi sarati, āgacchatipi uposathaṃ napi āgacchati, āgacchatipi saṅghakammaṃ napi āgacchati.
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.4: saṅgho gaggassa bhikkhuno ummattakassa ummattakasammutiṃ deti,
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.5: sareyya vā gaggo bhikkhu uposathaṃ na vā sareyya, sareyya vā saṅghakammaṃ na vā sareyya, āgaccheyya vā uposathaṃ na vā āgaccheyya, āgaccheyya vā saṅghakammaṃ na vā āgaccheyya. saṅgho saha vā gaggena vinā vā gaggena uposathaṃ karissati. saṅghakammaṃ karissati.
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.6: yassāyasmato khamati gaggassa bhikkhuno ummattakassa ummattakasammutiyā dānaṃ,
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.7: sareyya vā gaggo bhikkhu uposathaṃ na vā sareyya, sareyya vā saṅghakammaṃ na vā sareyya, āgaccheyya vā uposathaṃ na vā āgaccheyya, āgaccheyya vā saṅghakammaṃ na vā āgaccheyya. saṅgho saha vā gaggena vinā vā gaggena uposathaṃ karissati. saṅghakammaṃ karissati. so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.10: sareyya vā gaggo bhikkhu uposathaṃ na vā sareyya, sareyya vā saṅghakammaṃ na vā sareyya āgaccheyya vā uposathaṃ na vā āgaccheyya, āgaccheyya vā saṅghakammaṃ na vā āgaccheyya. saṅgho saha vā gaggena vinā vā gaggena uposathaṃ karissati. saṅghakammaṃ karissati.
pli-tv-kd2:25.4.11: khamati saṅghassa. tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahuposathe cattāro bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.1.4: ‘uposatho kātabbo’ti. mayañcamhā cattāro janā, kathannu kho amhehi uposatho kātabbo”ti?
pli-tv-kd2:26.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahuposathe tayo bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.2.3: “bhagavatā anuññātaṃ catunnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisituṃ. mayañcamhā tayo janā. kathannu kho amhehi uposatho kātabbo”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.3.2: byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena te bhikkhū ñāpetabbā:-
pli-tv-kd2:26.3.6: therena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjalimpaggahetvā te bhikkhū evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:26.4.1: “navakena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā, ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjalimpaggahetvā te bhikkhū evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-kd2:26.5.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahuposathe dve bhikkhū viharanti.
pli-tv-kd2:26.5.3: “bhagavatā anuññātaṃ catunnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisituṃ. tiṇṇannaṃ pārisuddhi uposathaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:26.6.2: therena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjalimpaggahetvā navo bhikkhu evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd2:26.7.1: “navakena bhikkhunā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjalimpaggahetvā thero bhikkhu evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd2:26.8.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahuposathe eko bhikkhu viharati.
pli-tv-kd2:26.8.3: “bhagavatā anuññātaṃ catunnaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisituṃ. tiṇṇaṃ pārisuddhi uposathaṃ kātuṃ. dvinnaṃ pārisuddhi uposathaṃ kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:26.9.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ āvāse tadahuposathe eko bhikkhu viharati,
pli-tv-kd2:26.9.2: tena bhikkhave, bhikkhunā yattha bhikkhū paṭikkamanti upaṭṭhāna sālāya vā maṇḍape vā rukkhamūle vā so deso sammajjitvā pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā āsanaṃ paññapetvā padīpaṃ katvā nisīditabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:26.9.3: sace aññe bhikkhū āgacchanti, tehi saddhiṃ uposatho kātabbo
pli-tv-kd2:26.9.4: no ce āgacchanti, ajja me uposathoti adhiṭṭhātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:26.10.1: tatra bhikkhave, yattha cattāro bhikkhū viharanti, na ekassa pārisuddhiṃ āharitvā tīhi pātimokkhaṃ uddisitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd2:26.10.3: tatra bhikkhave, yattha tayo bhikkhū viharanti, na ekassa pārisuddhiṃ āharitvā dvīhi pārisuddhi uposatho kātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:26.10.5: tatra bhikkhave, yattha dve bhikkhū viharanti, na ekassa pārisuddhiṃ āharitvā ekena adhiṭṭhātabbo.
pli-tv-kd2:27.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu tadahuposathe āpattiṃ āpanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:27.1.8: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu tadahuposathe āpattiṃ āpanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:27.1.9: tena bhikkhave, bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd2:27.1.10: ‘ahaṃ āvuso, itthannāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, taṃ paṭidesemī’ti.
pli-tv-kd2:27.2.1: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu tadahuposathe āpattiyā vematiko hoti.
pli-tv-kd2:27.2.2: tena bhikkhave, bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-kd2:27.2.4: yadā nibbematiko bhavissāmi, tadā taṃ āpattiṃ paṭikarissāmī’ti vatvā uposatho kātabbo. pātimokkhaṃ sotabbaṃ. natveva tappaccayā uposathassa antarāyo kātabbo”ti.
pli-tv-kd2:27.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sabhāgaṃ āpattiṃ desenti.
pli-tv-kd2:27.3.5: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sabhāgaṃ āpattiṃ paṭiggaṇhanti.
pli-tv-kd2:27.4.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne āpattiṃ sarati.
pli-tv-kd2:27.4.8: “idha pana bhikkhave, bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne āpattiṃ sarati.
